global_2s_diagnosis.measured_conclusion: All 5s-hit/2s-miss queries are speech-label visual-path diagnostics; their correct regions remain in the 2s top-20 while closer neighboring frames occupy the top five. The 2s top five also has fewer 5s temporal regions and a higher temporal redundancy rate than the 5s baseline.

global_5s.timing_note: Includes the historical run's model/cache state and is not a paired timing run.

global_2s.timing_note: Measured warm-model extraction plus CLIP encoding in the parent run.

decision.recommendation: Keep production 5-second raw CLIP unchanged. The 2-second top-50 pool reaches 97.62% held-out correct-region recall and 100% reviewed small-object visibility, but every cheap final-top-5 selector misses promotion gates. Revisit calibrated no-match only with a bounded candidate-list ranking experiment; keep Video RAG deferred until ranking and rejection both pass.
